headline: F1 The personal income tax thresholds in the published Act (9,090 + 120 + 240 pounds) are tiny: nearly every wage is taxed at 15 %

registry_correction: Registry 'Income Tax Act 1986; conflict' confirmed for the Government of Sudan: personal income tax Schedule III Sector (B) 0/5/10/15 % (9,090 / +120 / +240 pounds); the amounts are those of the 2013 amendment as printed; later finance laws not reached.
